purpose_context: felix-admin-capture and habits agent prompts have been merging to main but never reaching /data/services/openclaw/<agent>/ on office2 (1215-line repo AGENTS.md vs 950-line deployed for capture; same pattern for habits #561). This mission builds a stdlib Python helper invoked by a user-level systemd timer on office2: each tick does git fetch + git pull origin main in /home/claude/kg-automation, then MD5-compares each agent prompt file and atomically copies any drifted file into /data/services/openclaw/<deploy-dir>/. Slug to deploy-dir mapping is sourced from service-inventory.json (not 1:1 per the inbox-agent / habits-agent precedent). Result: every spec-kitty merge that touches an agent prompt lands on the running agent within one cron-tick window. Stranded #558 and #561 changes get deployed on first successful tick. No openclaw restart triggered.
purpose_tldr: Pull-based office2 pipeline that auto-syncs Felix agent prompts from repo to deployed location within 5 minutes of merge.
